label: Australian investment bond
help.scope: Model a tax-paid Australian life-insurance bond held by its original owner. Enter the insurer's net value growth and total premiums as the cost basis. Set a full surrender date to forecast the Australian tax.
field.inception: Date the insurer first took on the risk
help.inception: Use the insurer's commencement-of-risk date, even if the policy was purchased before this forecast.
help.restart: The first day of the most recent assurance year that restarted the ten-year period. Leave blank if the period still starts on the initial risk date.
field.confirmed: Eligible Australian tax-paid bond with no prior surrender or bonus
field.priorPremium: Premiums in the immediately preceding assurance year
help.premiumHistory: Complete the premium history if adding money to an existing policy. Count the first assurance year as 1. Enter 0 when forecasting a new policy or leaving an existing policy without further premiums.
invalid.scope: Confirm the bond is held by the original owner with no prior surrender or bonus.
invalid.inception: Enter the insurer's commencement-of-risk date after 7 December 1983.
invalid.restart: Enter a valid historical restart date from the insurer.
invalid.dividend: Enter the insurer's net value growth and leave the separate distribution rate at zero.
invalid.withdrawal: Use full surrender to release the bond. Ordinary partial withdrawals must be disabled.
invalid.premiumYear: Enter a whole assurance year number or zero.
